picks.title: Now Google says it might use your Gmail and Google Photos data to target ads
picks.rationale: Google's updated terms mean users who share Gmail and Photos data for Personal Intelligence AI recommendations also open it up to ad personalization. That is a new targeting signal advertisers on Google's AI surfaces will be bought against.
picks.excerpt: According to the new terms, sharing your data for better AI recommendations also means opening it up for more personalized ads.

picks.title: Google Ads Asset Optimization Sourced Videos Toggle
picks.rationale: A new 'Sourced videos' toggle in Google Ads asset optimization lets Google AI find videos from approved sources and add them to campaigns automatically. Advertisers should check whether it is on before AI-picked video creative starts running.
picks.excerpt: Google Ads has added a new "Sourced videos" on/off toggle setting to the asset optimization section.  This uses Google AI to identify relevant videos from your approved sources and add them to your campaign automatically.

picks.title: Etsy updates AI use policies to emphasize craftsmanship
picks.rationale: Etsy now requires at least one authentic, non-AI-generated image in most seller listings while it expands its own AI. That changes how marketplace sellers can produce the product imagery that sells their goods.
picks.excerpt: While it’s implementing more AI, the online marketplace now requires at least one authentic, non-AI generated image in most seller listings.

https://www.theverge.com/tech/1017600/go.new_action: New official Google terms/privacy-policy update: data shared with Personal Intelligence (Gmail, Google Photos) may now be used for ad personalization. The 10-17 card covered only the test of ads appearing in AI Mode for Personal Intelligence users, not the data-use terms change.
